name: Singed
title: the Mad Chemist

Q.name: Poison Trail
Q.description: Toggle: Singed lays a poisonous trail that deals 20/30/40/50/60 + 0.425×AP magic damage per second.
Q.summary: Leaves a trail of poison behind Singed, dealing damage to enemies caught in the path.

W.name: Mega Adhesive
W.description: Singed hurls a cask of sticky liquid, Grounding and Slowing enemies in the area by 50/55/60/65/70% for 3 seconds.
W.summary: Throws a vial of mega adhesive on the ground, slowing and grounding enemies who walk on it.

E.name: Fling
E.description: Singed flings an enemy over his shoulder, dealing 50/60/70/80/90 + 0.55×AP plus 6/6.5/7/7.5/8% max Health magic damage. If Singed flings a target into his Mega Adhesive, they are Rooted for 1/1.25/1.5/1.75/2 seconds.
E.summary: Damages target enemy unit and flings them into the air behind Singed. If the target Singed flings lands in his Mega Adhesive, they are also rooted.

R.name: Insanity Potion
R.description: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him 25/55/85 Ability Power, Armor, Magic Resist, Move Speed, Health Regen, and Mana Regen for 25 seconds. During this effect, Singed's Poison Trail also applies 40% Grievous Wounds for 1 second.
R.summary: Singed drinks a potent brew of chemicals, granting him increased combat stats, and making his Poison Trail apply Grievous Wounds.

Passive.name: Noxious Slipstream
Passive.description: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.
Passive.summary: Singed drafts off nearby champions, gaining a burst of Move Speed when passing them.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Tank who proxies waves and runs ahead of enemies leaving a poison trail. He flings enemies into his W glue to ground them.
strengths: E fling into W ground combo
profile.curveNote: Farms with Q; fights with W+E after 3.

E.notes: Fling over shoulder; roots if into W (not tagged). Stay out of melee range.

R.notes: Large stat boost; Q gains grievous wounds.

profile.windowAgainst: Don't chase; fight when E is down.
checks: E into W root not tagged
